summary: Acadia Pharmaceuticals filed a routine Form 8-K on September 11, 2026, disclosing that the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of California preliminarily approved, on August 24, 2026, a settlement of the stockholder derivative action Kanner et al. v. Biggar et al., Case No. 3:23-cv-02293-WQH-MSB. The filing attaches the Notice of Pendency and Proposed Settlement and the Stipulation as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, posted at ir.acadia.com. The action is not a class action, no common fund exists, and no monetary claim process is provided. This is ordinary litigation-disclosure housekeeping, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, price, stake, or regulatory clock is stated.
